routes.authority: extension-owned trusted UI in production; local simulation only in prototype

environment.evidence: checkedAt plus host/context identity; multiple blockers may coexist

viewPriority: select action scope; use-only blockers do not block compatible Sidebar installation
security-or-integrity-block applies to new commits/use; preserve in-flight reconciliation entry
active-operation or unknown-result-reconcile; loss of catalog is not loss of operation

bridge.trustedConfirmation: extension-owned UI with actual user action; public imitation is not authority
bridge.senderEvidence: browser-provided origin/url and required top-level document binding, never payload claims; fail closed if unavailable
bridge.nonce: short-lived, host-generated, source-and-plan-bound, never approval proof
bridge.recovery: persistent operation binding plus existing installer registry; connection state is not outcome
bridge.publicHandoff: explicit continue action then trusted host confirmation; no default automatic popup on GET
bridge.intentExpiry: Only unapproved intent expires; committed operation and receipt remain durable regardless of source page or nonce TTL

productionRecommended: short manually played video with poster

batchPolicy.cancel: stop not-started items; reconcile in-flight; retain committed installations
batchPolicy.retry: only definite failed items; unknown items query first; successful and skipped items not repeated
batchPolicy.versionConflictDefault: keep existing; explicit review to change
batchPolicy.permissionSummary: may group presentation, never merge app authorization identities
batchPolicy.rollback: no automatic uninstall; any user-requested removal needs exact new items and data impact review
batchPolicy.planBaseline: Advance rolling expected baseline for successful items of this batch; only unexpected external changes invalidate affected unstarted items
batchPolicy.uniqueMembers: One marketId per revision. Identical exact release duplicates may merge; conflicting versions/bytes block. Check both intra-batch local toolId conflicts and existing local registry ownership before installation.
batchPolicy.dataVersionCompatibility: Version changes require compatible persisted data or a trusted recoverable migration; approval alone cannot authorize unsafe downgrade.

transferPolicy.format: strict data-only metadata, not executable package
transferPolicy.contentMigration: separate application-specific export/import contract; not included in universal list
transferPolicy.execution: Sidebar transfer installation does not run business actions; Page after destination verification, grant and explicit enable follows its existing matching lifecycle
transferPolicy.dataVersionCompatibility: Reuse update schema compatibility and recoverable migration gate; preserve target on failure.
